name: has_high_qs_rank
description: Founder has at least one education with QS rank 10 or better.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_executive_experience
description: Founder has held a role as CEO, President, or Director for at least 2 years.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) >= 2 for job in founder.get('jobs', []) if job.get('role', '').lower() in ['ceo', 'president', 'director', 'founder'])

name: industry_in_tech
description: Founder is involved in the Technology, Information & Internet Platforms industry.
expression: lambda founder: 'technology, information & internet platforms' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_ipo
description: Founder has participated in an IPO.

name: has_acquisition
description: Founder has been involved in an acquisition.

name: education_in_field
description: Founder has an education in a specified field.
expression: lambda founder: any('computer science' in e.get('field', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_relevant_experience_years
description: Founder has at least 2 years in a relevant leadership role.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) >= 2 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_in_finance_or_banking
description: Founder is involved in the Financial Services or Banking industry.
expression: lambda founder: 'financial services' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'banking' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: education_in_top_qs
description: Founder has an education with QS ranking 5 or better.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 5 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: role_as_cofounder
description: Founder has held a role as Co-Founder.
expression: lambda founder: any('co-founder' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_in_healthcare
description: Founder is involved in Healthcare or Medical industries.
expression: lambda founder: 'healthcare' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'medical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_multiple_educations
description: Founder has more than one education record.

name: industry_in_software
description: Founder is involved in the Software Development industry.

name: role_in_leadership
description: Founder has held a leadership role (e.g., CEO, President, Director).
expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('role', '').lower() in ['ceo', 'president', 'director', 'founder', 'chairman'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_in_research
description: Founder is involved in Research or Higher Education industries.
expression: lambda founder: 'research' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'higher education' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_experience_in_industry
description: Founder has at least 2 years experience in their industry.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) >= 2 and (founder.get('industry', '').lower() in job.get('industry', '').lower() or True) for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: education_in_qs_top_50
description: Founder studied at an institution with QS rank 50 or better.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))
